title: I-Echo Efikelele Etroneni
intro: Umntu oxinezelekileyo wasondela kwisihlalo sobulungisa, ilizwi labo lingcangcazela kungengoloyiko kodwa linethemba. Le ngxaki yayiyeyomntu, kodwa isisombululo sayo sasiza kuvakala ngokuhamba kwexesha, sichitha isiko elicinezelayo. Ngubani lo mphefumlo osikhalazo sakhe savakala ngaphaya kweenkwenkwezi?
clues: Ndize nentliziyo enzima, ndifuna ubulungisa kwityala elalindibopha ulwimi.
Isicelo sam sasingesiso nje kumthunywa; sanyuka saya ngaphaya, kuLowo uva yonke into.
Amazwi athethwa nxamnye nam ayefana nemixokelelwane yexesha elidlulileyo.
Ndaxoxa ndaza ndaqiqa, ndilila kwaye ndinengqondo, ngenxa yesidima sam.
Kwavela isityhilelo, sathulisa iindlela zakudala saza saqonda intlungu yam.
Bandibiza ngokuba ndingulowo uxambulisana nomyeni wam, kwaye igama lam lafana nesahluko esandikhululayo.

arabic: قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَـٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verse: Certainly has Allāh heard the speech of the one who argues [i.e., pleads] with you, [O Muḥammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allāh. And Allāh hears your dialogue; indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing. (58:1)
